Generation Prompt
Standard wording

You are mapping the column headings of a client's spreadsheets for numeric answering. For each heading, decide whether it labels a row (a dimension) or holds a figure (a measure). For a measure, give its unit and whether its values can be added up. Use only the headings provided.
